title: Ao bodies relax ongoingagitation for three days

ai.summary: Ao organisations in Nagaland agreed to a three-day pause in their agitation to allow child immunisation and medication from November 5-7, 2026, but warned the protest would intensify after November 16 if demands for completing detachment reports by November 13 were not met.

facts.claim: Ao organisations have allowed a three-day relaxation in the ongoing agitation (closure of chief medical officer’s office Mokokchung) to facilitate child immunisation and medication from November 5-7, 2026.
facts.quote: DIMAPUR, NOV 3 (NPN): Ao organisations have allowed a three-day relaxation in the ongoing agitation (closure of chief medical officer’s office Mokokchung) to facilitate child immunisation and medication from November 5-7, 2026.

facts.claim: The decision was taken at a joint meeting of the Ao Senden, All Ward Union Mokokchung Town (AWUMT), Watsü Mungdang, Ao Kaketshir Mungdang (AKM) and Ao Lanur Telungjem (ALT) at Aor Kilem.
facts.quote: The decision was taken at a joint meeting of the Ao Senden, All Ward Union Mokokchung Town (AWUMT), Watsü Mungdang, Ao Kaketshir Mungdang (AKM) and Ao Lanur Telungjem (ALT) at Aor Kilem.

facts.claim: In a joint letter to DC Mokokchung, the five organisations said the relaxation was granted on humanitarian grounds.
facts.quote: In a joint letter to DC Mokokchung, the five organisations said the relaxation was granted on humanitarian grounds.

facts.claim: The organisations also resolved that all detachment and joining reports must be completed by November 13, following the 14-day period provided under the October 30 notification (No. MED-3A/1/2006(PT)/696) for completion of the handing and taking over process.
facts.quote: The organisations also resolved that all detachment and joining reports must be completed by November 13, following the 14-day period provided under the October 30 notification (No. MED-3A/1/2006(PT)/696) for completion of the handing and taking over process.

facts.claim: The organisations warned that the agitation would be intensified after a public rally in Mokokchung town on November 16 if the requirements were not fulfilled.
facts.quote: The organisations warned that the agitation would be intensified after a public rally in Mokokchung town on November 16 if the requirements were not fulfilled.

ai.background_note: Ao organisations in Nagaland paused their agitation for child immunisation and medication but warned of intensified protests if detachment reports aren't completed by November 13.
